Name: Cat recolor
Author: rietaflame
Description:
I was bored of the orange tabby cat, so I decided to make a different color. Then I couldn't decide what color to make it, so I made a few different ones.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://image.ibb.co/giAhiv/blackcat.png[/img][/url] Black Cat

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://image.ibb.co/cZCjwF/calicocat.png[/img][/url] Calico Cat

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://image.ibb.co/fYCTOv/greytabbycat.png[/img][/url] Grey Tabby Cat

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://image.ibb.co/c6Q4wF/whitecat.png[/img][/url] White Cat



To install, just go to your Stardew Valley content/animals folder:  
  
[i]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\content\animals  [/i]
  
And replace the cat.xnb with the downloaded one provided.
